summary: Draws a string field as a Tag dropdown.
overview: Put it above a string and the Inspector shows the tag picker instead of a text box — which removes the typo that makes a CompareTag silently never match.
useCases: A required-tag field on a trigger or detector.
Any string that must be one of the project's tags.

gotchas.title: It does not validate an existing value
gotchas.body: A tag renamed or deleted later leaves the old string in the field. The dropdown shows valid choices; it does not fix stale ones.
